# E3 tables (generated by `experiments/analyze_e3.py`; protocol docs/e3_protocol.md)

Code `fc74aef9` + patch `e3b0c44298fc1c14`. Estimators: MLE (EM), MAP (κ₀ = 30 toward q̄), PP (grid posterior predictive), MOM (pair-sum moments).
